programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When the Principal's cat goes missing, Theodore gives her a music box. When Dave discovers his Grandma's music box is missing, he calls the police. Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box. Now Simon and Alvin have to get him home.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When one of Simon's inventions malfunctions, Jeanette and Alvin switch places and now each must live as the other.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When his brothers won't listen to Theodore's song, he posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit. Soon Theodore, now Lil T, is offered a solo career.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin invites Dave's old high school rival to an elaborate dinner to prove to him that Dave is a huge success. The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realise what they'll be leaving behind.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Run Aimee Run; Theo vs. Simon

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Lost in Space ... Camp; Super Hot Chocolate

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.
